title: Open problems for the recursive atom-knot atlas
html:
Open

  • Principled derivation for {}^{6}Li, {}^{7}Li (and any new atom): the Gröbner–Shirshov filtration grade and the jet-order events are computed exactly in symbolic q on the test braids \sigma_1^3 (electron) and (\sigma_1 \sigma_2^{-1})^3 (proton/neutron body). The difficulty is that this filtration and jet ordering must remain consistent across all confinement levels \ell at once, which forces a joint SDP on the full mass tower — over all \ell and all atoms simultaneously — yielding a canonical T_w \in H_{n_0}(q_0) per atom as a structured certificate. The Markov closure of T_w is then taken in S^3 and \mathrm{Vol}_{\mathrm{hyp}} is computed at \geq 50 decimal digits via hp_volume_of_link_closure(braid_word, digits=50); comparison to the AME binding energy happens a posteriori. A per-atom volume-match search is not an admissible derivation route, since it cannot keep the GB filtration and jet ordering consistent across confinement levels. Until the joint SDP is run, no principled {}^{6}Li / {}^{7}Li entry exists.
  • Structural rule for \rho in B = \rho \cdot m_e \cdot \mathrm{Vol}(K): the pattern \rho \in \{1, 2\} for \ell \leq 2 atoms does not extend to {}^{6}Li, {}^{7}Li. Open: derive \rho(Z, N) from ILP / confinement structure.
  • Hyperbolic-knot identification beyond \ell = 2: {}^{9}Be, {}^{11}B, {}^{14}N — no entries are in scope until a principled (GB-NF) derivation exists. Volume-match search will not be used.
  • Photon \rho-factor: photon mass = 0 by definition (no \rho needed), but for the recursive structure may tie to gauge-boson Higgs coupling.
